name: code-listen-cursor
description: Hear selected code as structure-aware speech without sending source off-device.

scripts.build:site: npm run build:extension && npm run package:extension && npm run build:vscode && vite build --config vite.site.config.ts
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck && node --check tests/*.mjs && node --check scripts/*.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:package && npm run test:extension && node tests/installed-package-privacy.mjs && node tests/vscode-package-integration.mjs && npm run test:e2e
